title: textops Module
content_markdown:
The module implements text based operations over the SIP message processed by OpenSIPS. SIP is a text based protocol and the module provides a large set of very useful functions to manipulate the message at text level, e.g., regular expression search and replace, Perl-like substitutions, etc.

Note: all SIP-aware functions like _insert_hf_, _append_hf_ or _codec_ operations have been moved to the _sipmsgops_ module.
overview:

Note: all SIP-aware functions like _insert_hf_, _append_hf_ or _codec_ operations have been moved to the _sipmsgops_ module.

exported_functions.name: search
exported_functions.description: Searches for the re in the message.

exported_functions.name: search_body
exported_functions.description: Searches for the re in the body of the message.

exported_functions.name: search_append
exported_functions.description: Searches for the first match of re and appends txt after it.

exported_functions.name: search_append_body
exported_functions.description: Searches for the first match of re in the body of the message and appends txt after it.

exported_functions.name: replace
exported_functions.description: Replaces the first occurrence of re with txt.

exported_functions.name: replace_body
exported_functions.description: Replaces the first occurrence of re in the body of the message with txt.

exported_functions.name: replace_all
exported_functions.description: Replaces all occurrence of re with txt.

exported_functions.name: replace_body_all
exported_functions.description: Replaces all occurrence of re in the body of the message with txt. Matching is done on a per-line basis.

exported_functions.name: replace_body_atonce
exported_functions.description: Replaces all occurrence of re in the body of the message with txt. Matching is done over the whole body.

exported_functions.name: subst

parameters.name: '/re/repl/flags'
parameters.description: sed like regular expression. flags can be a combination of i (case insensitive), g (global) or s (match newline don't treat it as end of line). 're' - is regular expression 'repl' - is replacement string - may contain pseudo-variables 'flags' - substitution flags (i - ignore case, g - global)

exported_functions.description: Replaces re with repl (sed or perl like).

exported_functions.name: subst_uri

parameters.name: '/re/repl/flags'
parameters.description: sed like regular expression. flags can be a combination of i (case insensitive), g (global) or s (match newline don't treat it as end of line). 're' - is regular expression 'repl' - is replacement string - may contain pseudo-variables 'flags' - substitution flags (i - ignore case, g - global)

exported_functions.description: Runs the re substitution on the message uri (like subst but works only on the uri)

examples.code:
...
# adds 3463 prefix to numeric uris, and save the original uri (\\0 match)
# as a parameter: orig\_uri (just an example)
if (subst\_uri('/^sip:(\[0-9\]+)@(.)\*)$/sip:3463\\1@\\2;orig\_uri=\\0/i')){$

# adds the avp 'uri\_prefix' as prefix to numeric uris, and save the original
# uri (\\0 match) as a parameter: orig\_uri (just an example)
if (subst\_uri('/^sip:(\[0-9\]+)@(.)\*)$/sip:$avp(uri\_prefix)\\1@\\2;orig\_uri=\\0/i')){$

...
examples.description: adds 3463 prefix to numeric uris, and save the original uri (\\0 match) as a parameter: orig\_uri (just an example) / adds the avp 'uri\_prefix' as prefix to numeric uris, and save the original uri (\\0 match) as a parameter: orig\_uri (just an example)

exported_functions.name: subst_user

parameters.name: '/re/repl/flags'
parameters.description: sed like regular expression. flags can be a combination of i (case insensitive), g (global) or s (match newline don't treat it as end of line). 're' - is regular expression 'repl' - is replacement string - may contain pseudo-variables 'flags' - substitution flags (i - ignore case, g - global)

exported_functions.description: Runs the re substitution on the message uri (like subst_uri but works only on the user portion of the uri)

examples.code:
...
# adds 3463 prefix to uris ending with 3642 (just an example)
if (subst\_user('/3642$/36423463/')){$
...
# adds avp 'user\_prefix' as prefix to username in r-uri ending with 3642
if (subst\_user('/(.)\*)3642$/$avp(user\_prefix)\\13642/')){$

...
examples.description: adds 3463 prefix to uris ending with 3642 (just an example) / adds avp 'user\_prefix' as prefix to username in r-uri ending with 3642
